args.title: Juniper Labware – Retail Returns Logistics (3-bullet summary)
args.body:
Combined summary of the Juniper Labware newsletter, its linked article, and the companion piece:

- Apparel return rates have reached 24%.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth (~20%).
- Resale within 10 days kept most of the margin.

Sources:
- Newsletter: Juniper Labware, "Retail returns logistics" (newsletter@juniper.example)
- Article: https://blog.juniper.example/2026/returns
- Companion: https://insights.juniper.example/returns/companion (accessed with tomas.ferreira@northwind.example)
